title: The Original Dixieland Band's credit for tunes
summary: He says the Dixieland band took credit for older tunes, their agent Max Hart copyrighted everything, and only a few pieces were original.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song
